selection_rule: Highest mean ROC-AUC in repeated stratified cross-validation on the training split (ties broken by F1). The test split was not used for selection.

source.name: Heart Disease Data Set (14-attribute processed form of the UCI Cleveland/Hungarian/Swiss/Long Beach data)
source.original_citation: Janosi A., Steinbrunn W., Pfisterer M., Detrano R. (1988). Heart Disease. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C52P4X
source.original_license: CC BY 4.0 (as stated by the UCI Machine Learning Repository)
source.retrieval_note: The UCI host (archive.ics.uci.edu) was not reachable from the build environment, so a public GitHub copy of the widely redistributed 14-column heart.csv was used. That redistribution carries no licence file of its own; reuse is governed by the original UCI licence. The copy could not be diffed against the UCI originals.
